steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have a working mini framework. Linear layers, ReLU, dropout, batch norm, Adam, a DataLoader, a training loop. It trains a 4-layer network on a circle classification problem in pure Python.
It is also 500x slower than PyTorch on the same problem.
